OPTION_FRIEND_TRADE_CARD.name: Trade Card
OPTION_FRIEND_TRADE_CARD.description: Choose another player and a card from your deck. If they choose you with [gold]Trade Card[/gold], you exchange cards.
OPTION_FRIEND_TRADE_RELIC.name: Trade Relic
OPTION_FRIEND_TRADE_RELIC.description: Choose another player and a tradable relic. If they choose you with [gold]Trade Relic[/gold], you exchange relics. Relics with [gold]on-pickup[/gold] effects cannot be traded.
